body: Blocked drains are a frequent plumbing issue in St Kilda homes, often caused by grease buildup, hair, or foreign objects. To prevent blockages, avoid pouring oils down sinks and use drain screens to catch debris. Regular cleaning with natural solutions like baking soda and vinegar can maintain flow without harsh chemicals.

St Kilda's coastal location means salt air and sand can enter drainage systems, contributing to clogs. Additionally, tree roots seeking moisture in Melbourne's dry periods often invade sewer lines. Installing root barriers and scheduling annual drain inspections with Grade A Plumbing can identify and address these issues early.

Older plumbing in St Kilda suburbs may have deteriorating pipes that trap debris. Upgrading to modern PVC pipes or relining existing ones can improve drainage. Our plumbers assess pipe condition during routine maintenance and recommend repairs to prevent emergencies.

Outdoor drainage is also critical, especially with Melbourne's heavy rains. Ensure gutters and stormwater drains are clear of leaves and debris to avoid backyard flooding. Educating household members about what not to flush is essential. Items like wet wipes, sanitary products, and food scraps commonly cause blockages. We advise St Kilda residents on best practices and provide emergency clearing services if blockages occur.

Finally, consider installing a grease trap for commercial properties in St Kilda to prevent sewer blockages.
